task_description: Write a method in Dafny to interleave 3 sequence of the same length into a single flat sequence.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method InterleaveThreeSequences(s1: seq<int>, s2: seq<int>, s3: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the result sequence should be three times the length of each input sequence
- The result sequence should contain all elements of s1, s2, and s3 in an interleaved manner, preserving the order of elements within each input sequence
- The elements from s1, s2, and s3 should appear in the result sequence in a repeating pattern corresponding to their original order
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.  
In this case:  
```dafny
method Interleave3Sequences(s1: seq<int>, s2: seq<int>, s3: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
```  

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.  
Natural language description:  
- All input sequences should have the same length.  
- Sequences are not null (by Dafny's default semantics, sequences are always non-null).  

Dafny specification:  
```dafny
requires |s1| == |s2| == |s3|
```  

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.  
Natural language description:  
- The resulting sequence contains elements from s1, s2, s3 interleaved in order: first element of s1, then s2, then s3, then second element of s1, s2, s3, and so on.  
- The length of the result sequence is three times the length of each input sequence.  

Dafny specification:  
```dafny
ensures |result| == 3 * |s1|
ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |s1| ==> result[3*i] == s1[i]
ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |s2| ==> result[3*i + 1] == s2[i]
ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |s3| ==> result[3*i + 2] == s3[i]
```  

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations.  
```dafny
method Interleave3Sequences(s1: seq<int>, s2: seq<int>, s3: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires |s1| == |s2| == |s3|
    ensures |result| == 3 * |s1|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |s1| ==> result[3*i] == s1[i]
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |s2| ==> result[3*i + 1] == s2[i]
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |s3| ==> result[3*i + 2] == s3[i]
{
    var n := |s1|;
    result := [];

    var i := 0;
    while i < n
        invariant 0 <= i <= n
        invariant |result| == 3 * i
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> result[3*k] == s1[k]
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> result[3*k + 1] == s2[k]
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> result[3*k + 2] == s3[k]
    {
        result := result + [s1[i], s2[i], s3[i]];
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
